name: Portabase Self-Hosted Database Backups
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed self-hosted backup and restore management for databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite and MongoDB, with agents and storage destinations; no vendor-metered backup quota for the open-source software.
watch_out: Self-host the management server and agents, configure storage/retention and verify restorations; backup destinations, storage capacity and compute are not supplied free. Some database engines and operations have different restore capabilities; review official compatibility docs.
